description: Default permissions. fs:scope is '**' because the file WATCHER is the only thing still using the fs plugin and has to reach whatever project is open; $HOME/** silently refused every workspace outside the home directory, so external-change detection was inert for exactly the projects most likely to have another tool writing to them. This removes no boundary: the app's own commands (read_file, write_file, read_dir, file_stats) take a path and use it, so the plugin scope never limited what the editor could touch - it only made a few features work in some folders and not others.
